more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-5 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1977). This is the combined limit for adipic acid and its specified salts.
more_info.overview: Sodium adipate is a sodium salt of adipic acid, specified as a distinct chemical preparation for food manufacture. Its acidity-regulating role is to adjust or maintain the pH of the food. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; flavoured drinks; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products; desserts excluding products covered in categories 1, 3 and 4.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
